rules.title: Storage permits anonymous reads
rules.description: A collected policy or public ACL permits anonymous reads. Effective access still depends on surrounding controls.
rules.remediation: Remove anonymous grants and validate application access using a nonprivileged principal.
rules.severity_basis: High potential data disclosure from an anonymous read grant; owner sensitivity determines impact.

rules.title: Storage encryption is disabled
rules.description: At-rest encryption is explicitly disabled in the supplied evidence. A missing setting is unknown, not disabled.
rules.remediation: Enable provider encryption; separately evaluate key ownership and rotation requirements.
rules.severity_basis: Loss of at-rest confidentiality protection under storage compromise; does not itself establish external exposure.

rules.title: Storage access logging is disabled
rules.description: The inspected access logging channel is disabled. Other audit channels may exist and require separate verification.
rules.remediation: Enable the appropriate access audit channel with retention and least-privilege log storage.
rules.severity_basis: Audit and investigation visibility gap; lower direct compromise contribution than a public data grant.

rules.title: Storage transport protection is absent
rules.description: Evidence explicitly indicates that HTTPS transport is not enforced.
rules.remediation: Enforce HTTPS and minimum TLS requirements after compatibility testing.
rules.severity_basis: Transport confidentiality and integrity protection gap; exploitability depends on actual traffic and network position.

rules.title: Storage permits anonymous access configuration
rules.description: The account can permit public containers. This setting alone does not prove an anonymously readable container.
rules.remediation: Disable account-level anonymous access where public content is not an approved requirement.
rules.severity_basis: Public configuration capability rather than observed data exposure; lower anchor than STO001.

rules.title: Network has a broad inbound administration rule
rules.description: An enabled inbound rule permits Internet-wide SSH or RDP. Routing, instance binding and higher-priority denies determine actual reachability.
rules.remediation: Restrict sources to approved administration networks or use a bastion. Validate effective routes and rules.
rules.severity_basis: Potential external administration entry point; effective reachability is separately assessed.

rules.title: Identity has a broad privilege grant
rules.description: A broad grant is present. Boundaries, denies, conditions and resource policies can restrict effective authorization.
rules.remediation: Review the grant, scope and dependencies; reduce privileges only after owner approval and operational tests.
rules.severity_basis: Broad authorization can amplify a compromised identity; limiting policies and alternate grants remain contextual.

rules.title: Console user has no registered MFA device
rules.description: A console-enabled user has no registered MFA device in the inspected IAM API. Federation and conditional access require separate checks.
rules.remediation: Require approved MFA or use federation; verify enforcement rather than relying only on device registration.
rules.severity_basis: Missing registered MFA for a console user weakens an account takeover defense; enforcement still needs review.

rules.title: Identity has no observed activity for over 90 days
rules.description: A complete declared telemetry window contains no activity for over 90 days. This is a review candidate, not proof of unnecessary access.
rules.remediation: Check seasonal, recovery and automation duties, missing data-plane logs and ownership before changing access.
rules.severity_basis: Dormancy is a governance review signal rather than proof of misuse; deliberately lower severity.

rules.title: Workload has an exploitable vulnerability signal
rules.description: A native or imported vulnerability assessment marks an exploitable condition. CVSS is used only if supplied.
rules.remediation: Patch or isolate after testing; confirm asset mapping and rescan to validate the fix.
rules.severity_basis: Supplied CVSS normalized to [0,1]; fallback 0.9 only for an explicit exploitability assertion without CVSS.

rules.title: Workload security monitoring is disabled
rules.description: The collected signal explicitly reports missing workload monitoring. This project does not deploy a runtime agent.
rules.remediation: Enable workload protection and validate detection events and coverage.
rules.severity_basis: Loss of workload detection visibility; a missing monitoring channel is not proof of compromise.

rules.title: Workload is reachable from the Internet
rules.description: A supplied reachability assessment asserts Internet access. A public IP alone is not accepted as this assertion.
rules.remediation: Reduce reachability using approved ingress, private endpoints or tested segmentation.
rules.severity_basis: Internet reachability increases opportunity but may be an approved service requirement; exploit signal is separate.

rules.title: Cluster-admin role bound to an unauthenticated or over-privileged group
rules.description: Cluster-admin role bound to an unauthenticated or over-privileged group; permits broad workload compromise within a Kubernetes environment.
rules.remediation: Restrict cluster-admin bindings to trusted users.
rules.severity_basis: Author policy anchor; review risk methodology

rules.title: Missing network policies allowing unrestricted pod-to-pod communication
rules.description: Missing network policies allowing unrestricted pod-to-pod communication; facilitates lateral movement, though exploitability depends on network topology.
rules.severity_basis: Author policy anchor; review risk methodology

rules.title: Missing at-rest encryption for a graph database or relational instance
rules.description: Missing at-rest encryption for a graph database or relational instance; loss of confidentiality upon underlying volume compromise without establishing direct network exposure.
rules.remediation: Enable at-rest encryption on database volumes.
rules.severity_basis: Author policy anchor; review risk methodology

rules.title: Unclassified or unconsented PII discovered in unmanaged storage
rules.description: Unclassified or unconsented Personal Identifiable Information (PII) discovered in unmanaged storage; severe regulatory impact depending on data sensitivity mapping.
rules.remediation: Classify and secure PII using DSPM controls.
rules.severity_basis: Author policy anchor; review risk methodology

rules.title: Missing or misconfigured continuous vulnerability telemetry agent
rules.description: Missing or misconfigured continuous vulnerability telemetry agent (e.g., Defender or Wazuh); represents a security monitoring gap rather than a direct exploit path.
rules.remediation: Deploy and verify security telemetry agents.
rules.severity_basis: Author policy anchor; review risk methodology
